_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Cocoa Beach & the Space Coast. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Brevard Zoo
deals.deal: $5 off onsite admission for military, veterans and families
deals.details: Current military members and veterans, plus spouses or dependents, with proof of service. Discounts must be purchased at the zoo.

deals.name: Brevard Zoo
deals.deal: $18 admission for Florida seniors 65+, Dec 1-24
deals.details: Florida residents 65 and older with a state-issued photo ID (or utility bill with matching photo ID). Cannot be combined with other discounts.

deals.name: Cocoa Beach Kayaking
deals.deal: $5 off for military and first responders
deals.details: For first responders (police, firefighters, medics), active duty and retired military; bring military or first responder ID.

deals.name: Cocoa Kayaking
deals.deal: Discounts for military, teachers, police, firefighters, nurses and seniors
deals.details: Guided kayak tours from Cocoa Beach, Merritt Island and Titusville. The site does not state the discount amount.

deals.name: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex
deals.deal: Year-round senior and military family admission discounts
deals.details: The visitor complex states senior and military family admission discounts are available year-round; amounts are not listed on the FAQ page.

deals.name: Alibi Cocktails & Bites
deals.deal: $5-$7 classic cocktails + half-off wine (bottles included), weekdays 4-6 PM, Sat-Sun 12-3 PM
deals.details: Happy hour cocktails include a $6 margarita, $6 old fashioned and $5 daiquiri; appetizers such as fish dip ($7) and veggie pot stickers ($6) are also on the happy hour menu.

deals.name: Fire & Bloom Coastal Kitchen
deals.deal: Happy hour Wed-Sat 3-5:30 PM
deals.details: Craft cocktails and food during happy hour Wednesday through Saturday, 3 to 5:30 PM; the page lists no prices.

deals.name: Fishlips Waterfront Bar & Grill
deals.deal: 3 PM happy hour, Mon-Fri
deals.details: The restaurant's events calendar lists a 3 PM happy hour Monday through Friday; no prices or end time are listed.

deals.name: Florida's Fresh Grill
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 4-6 PM at the bar and patio
deals.details: Happy hour includes hand-crafted cocktails such as the cucumber Collins, espresso martini and maple old fashioned; the page lists no prices.

deals.name: Frigate's Waterfront Bar & Grill
deals.deal: $5 wells, $4 house wines, $3 domestic bottles and drafts, Mon-Fri 3-6:30 PM
deals.details: Happy hour Monday through Friday, 3 to 6:30 PM.

deals.name: Long Doggers (Cocoa Beach)
deals.deal: $3 Hatteras Red and Bud Light drafts + $4 wells, Mon-Fri 2-6 PM
deals.details: Cocoa Beach happy hour, dine-in only: $1 off local craft beers and wines by the glass, $5 Tito's or Captain Morgan, $6 'Ritas and frozen piña coladas.
deals.location: Cocoa Beach Causeway · 350 W Cocoa Beach Causeway

deals.name: Meg O'Malley's
deals.deal: $3 Guinness at 3 PM, Mon-Fri
deals.details: Happiest O'Hours runs Monday through Friday starting at 3 PM, with double loyalty points on happy hour menu items.
deals.location: Downtown Melbourne · 812 E New Haven Ave

deals.name: SharkPit Bar & Grill
deals.deal: Happy hour every day, 4-6 PM
deals.details: Daily happy hour from 4 to 6 PM; the page lists no specific prices.

deals.name: Squid Lips (Melbourne)
deals.deal: Half off the entire bar, Mon-Fri 3-6 PM, Fri-Sun 9 PM-close, Sat-Sun 11 AM-2 PM
deals.details: Excludes double pours, buckets and other existing specials.

deals.name: Time Out Plus Sports Bar & Restaurant
deals.deal: $2.75 16 oz domestic drafts + $5 craft drafts daily
deals.details: Daily drink specials also include $5 Bud or Bud Light pitchers with a food purchase, $5 Cutwater vodka, and buy two glasses of wine at the same time to get the whole bottle.

deals.name: Cajun Soul Bistro & Bar
deals.deal: $1 wings Wednesday + $8 smash burgers Thursday
deals.details: Wing Wednesday is $1 wings all day. Happy hour with drink specials runs Thursday and Friday, 5 to 7 PM, and Sunday brunch (11 AM-3 PM) has $20 bottomless mimosas.

deals.name: Rusty's Seafood & Oyster Bar
deals.deal: $14 early bird specials daily, 11 AM-6 PM
deals.details: Dine-in only. Choices include fish of the day, fried shrimp, sirloin steak, chicken, shrimp scampi and pasta, and a rice and bean bowl.

deals.name: Squid Lips (Melbourne)
deals.deal: $6.99 happy hour bites Mon-Fri 3-6 PM + weekly dinner specials after 4 PM
deals.details: Happy hour munchies include calamari, chicken tenders and fish dip at $6.99. After 4 PM: double fish and chips $16.99 Monday, Mountain of Shrimp $17.99 Tuesday, 25% off any burger Wednesday (beverage purchase required, dine-in only).

deals.name: The Fat Snook
deals.deal: Half-priced starters, Mon-Fri 4-6 PM (excludes oysters)
deals.details: Happy hour starters include seared scallops ($10) and grilled tiger shrimp ($9.50), with $7 house wines and $6-$7 rotating drafts.

deals.name: Time Out Plus Sports Bar & Restaurant
deals.deal: $8.95 daily food specials, 11 AM-11 PM
deals.details: Daily specials include a 12 oz burger with chips (or 20% off any burger), six wings with chips, a fried chicken sandwich, and a chicken, spinach and artichoke wrap; cod sliders are $8.95 from 11 AM to 3 PM.
